response.overview: The city of Moundsville is under siege by a werewolf, one that has an uncontrollable urge when around a certain female anatomy. Can the Police track this frenzied beast before more women are put under the spell of his grasp or will every woman vie for maximum pleasure. Will the beasts hairy paws be able to get a tight grip on the beaming glow of the full moon and finally break the curse of the BUBIWULF!
response.title: BUBIWULF!
